answer: Cap each agent's throughput by locked stake: allowed actions per epoch grow only with the stake an identity locks, like a trellis that lets a vine climb only as high as its frame. Splitting stake across fake identities gains nothing — ten shale-thin accounts share the same total quota as one honest agent, so a sybil swarm pays full price per unit of work. Orders use commit-reveal, so no identity can front-run the rest, and anyone caught gaming the quota stands on a ledge: peers can slash the stake and its quota collapses.
